Pasta Salad Ideas
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 13, 2009 - 11:38pm

Ingredients




chopped onions
sliced carrots
sliced celery
chopped green peppers
chopped red peppers
chopped yellow peppers
canned garbanzo beans drained
canned Kidney beans drained
canned corn drained
sliced ripe olives
sliced green olives
minced garlic
cherry tomatoes halved
artichoke hearts quartered Dressings (all lo-fat of course):
Italian (zesty/ parmesan style/ caesar style/ honey d
garlic & herbs

Preparation

1 Since you probably want the flavor, textures & colors of the foods in the pasta to show, don't use any "creamy" type dressing - almost any 'clear' dressing will do the job - if you want, consider a simple vinaigrette dressing and add different seasonings adjusting as necessary
